 1. Conformation of Appointment — Madeline Landrau, Water & Sewer Commission  
 
Minutes: 
On July 23, 2026, the General Government Committee, chaired by Councilor Justin Hurst, met to 
consider the appointment of Maddy Landrau to the Springfield Water and Sewer Commission. 
Landrau described her community partnership work with the MassMutual Foundation and 
expressed an interest in learning about the Commission’s operations, educating residents, and 
asking questions about infrastructure, water rates, and other issues affecting the community. It 
was confirmed that she would replace Vanessa Otero. Councilors discussed the impact of rising 
water and sewer rates and the importance of community communication and representation. The 
committee unanimously approved a motion by Councilor Victor Davila, seconded by Councilor 
Gerry Martin, to recommend Landrau’s appointment to the full City Council for confirmation.  
 
The meeting adjourned at 12:20 p.m
